labels.label: bcor:quo

hypotheses.paper: S complete Riemannian, f an isometric immersion
hypotheses.note: DEC-35: S a Cauchy surface of M with DevelopsCC ((CC') for Sigma = D(p^-1 S), D injective on p^-1 S)

hypotheses.paper: S-tilde the universal cover of S, Gamma = pi_1(S)
hypotheses.note: S-tilde := p^-1(S) in the universal cover of M; Gamma := rho(Deck(M~ -> M))

sorries.obstruction: proper discontinuity of Gamma on Sigma needs (1) D|S~ : S~ -> Sigma a homeomorphism (Barbot's 'D o f~ is an embedding', from Prop 8.1, not carried by (CC') as designed: S~ must be shown a local graph over open sets of R^d in flat charts so that the injective D|S~ is open), and (2) the deck group of M~ -> M acting properly discontinuously on M~; neither is in the library or the port

findings: Proved sorry-free from DevelopsCC: rho injective, rho(Gamma) preserves Sigma and acts freely on it, Sigma meets every timelike line (CCPrime). 'f and D o f~ are embeddings' and the immersion form are not derivable from (CC') without the local-graph structure of S~ (l.2266).

Not proved, disclosed in SCOPE: the design's conjunct IsPreconnected S~ (S~ = p^-1 S). Sigma = D(S~) is preconnected (CCAction.isPreconnected), so it follows once D|S~ : S~ -> Sigma is a homeomorphism, fact (1) of holonomy_proper's sorry.

Non-vacuity (kb/0011): developsCC_minkowski inhabits DevelopsCC with M = Minkowski d, D = proj (injective: Minkowski space is simply connected), rho = 1, S = {t = 0}; bcor_quo is instantiated on it in an example. Nontrivial holonomy is still not witnessed.
questions: DevelopsCC carries no topological-embedding field for D|S~; adding one (it is what Prop 8.1 provides) would discharge holonomy_proper's first half. Should the bridge (CauchyComplete) export it?

labels.label: bdef:U_g
findings: W4 confirmed: U(id) = emptyset (id is nonspacelike elliptic), so U(Gamma) must range over gamma != 1; Omega_g over q != 0.

l.2343 'J the lightlike affine line of fixed points': for a linear parabolic g with R = id the fixed set c + ker(L(g) - id) has dimension n-2, not a line; J is read as the null direction nullPart U through a fixed point c, and J^perp as the union over decompositions L(g) = R U and fixed points of c + (nullPart U)^perp.
The last branch Ug = Omega_g covers exactly 'loxodromic, spacelike elliptic, non linear parabolic' given the trichotomy (classes_of_not, through LorentzTrichotomy).
questions: Uniqueness of the parabolic decomposition (hence of J) is not proved; the union reading is independent of it. Accept?

labels.label: blem:SdanU

hypotheses.note: DEC-35: CCAction = (CC') + Gamma-invariant + free + properly discontinuous on Sigma

findings: NO sorry: fully proved in the (CC') reading; markable if the master accepts DEC-35's hypotheses and W4 as the statement.

The paper's interior argument (l.2383-2389: 'the complement of U(gamma) is a union of lightlike geodesics') is false for loxodromic gamma: through a point with xy > 0 every null line leaves {xy >= 0} (along (x+sa)(y+sb) with 2ab + |w|^2 = 0). Repaired: D(Sigma) subset U(Gamma) (domain of dependence, LipschitzGraph) and Sigma subset int D(Sigma).
The transverse parabolic case needs no Lemma 7.1 (false for d >= 3, AchronalDomains): Sigma subset Omega_gamma and Omega_gamma = emptyset.
Torsion is excluded first: a finite-order isometry is nonspacelike elliptic (isNonspacelikeElliptic_of_pow_eq_one, barycentres), whose timelike fixed line meets Sigma.

labels.label: bdef:omega_gamma
findings: Depends on the W4 reading of U(Gamma). Omega(S~) defined as the union of components of Omega(Gamma) meeting Sigma; it is one component under CCAction (omegaS_eq).

labels.label: bprop:ghyp

hypotheses.note: lorentzTrichotomy := fun _ hA => lorentz_trichotomy hA (Flat/Isometries, proved by the WP-30d fixer); bprop_ghyp_of_trichotomy keeps the named Prop LorentzTrichotomy as hypothesis

findings: W8: 'convexity of the connected components of every U(gamma)' (l.2430-2431) is false for U(gamma) = Omega_gamma loxodromic with tau != 0 (Omega_gamma = {xy <= 0}, connected, not convex); and convexity of components of each U(gamma) does not give convexity of the components of int(intersection) (interior of an infinite intersection). Repair: the piece property (segments and diamonds of two points of a connected subset of int A lie in A), proved class by class, stable under intersection, and a neighbourhood argument giving convexity and causal convexity of the components (convex_causallyConvex_connectedComponentIn).
Global hyperbolicity is ETT's (causal + compact diamonds) from causal convexity; Beem-Ehrlich and 'distinguished' are not used.
Gamma-invariance of Omega(S~) needs conjugation invariance of the classes and of J^perp (smul_mem_Ug), not stated in the paper.

Fixer pass: no sorry in this file for bprop_ghyp. #print axioms still shows sorryAx, because the Isometries olean on disk (built 16:29) predates the proof of lorentz_trichotomy in its source (edited 22:55). It becomes sorry-free when Isometries is rebuilt, with no change here. Not marked: proved in the DEC-35/W4 readings.

labels.label: bprop:splitting
findings: The lift half ('any nonspacelike geodesic in M~ intersects S~') is proved sorry-free for any flat covering (covering map + local isometry). The homeomorphism M = S x R is not treated here (CausalScaffold.Splitting; its flow is a sorry).

labels.label: bprop:danom

hypotheses.paper: M Cauchy-complete GH with S a complete Cauchy hypersurface

sorries.obstruction: step 1 (injectivity of D, l.2476-2485): the component of D^-1(vertical line) through a point is an inextensible causal curve of M~ (maximal lift through the local homeomorphism D, which is not a covering) - not in the library (WAVE3 risk R1)
used through ccAction_of_developsCC for D(Sigma) subset U(Gamma)

findings: W7 confirmed and repaired without slices: given injectivity, D is an isometric embedding, Sigma is a Cauchy surface of the open D(M~) (transported from isCauchySurface_liftSet), hence D(M~) subset D(Sigma) subset U(Gamma) (Lemma 8.6's core), and D(M~) open connected containing Sigma lies in Omega(S~). The design's step 4 (Gamma free and achronal on Omega') is not needed.

labels.label: remplacefini

sorries.obstruction: U(g^n) = U(g): Omega_{g^n} subset Omega_g and the stability of 'nonspacelike elliptic', 'linear parabolic' and of the hyperplanes c + J^perp under nonzero powers need the normal forms of sections 6-7 class by class (lorentz_trichotomy is now available) and the mutual exclusivity of the classes for a power, which nothing in the library states

findings: Under W4, U(Gamma') = U(Gamma) for finite index is false with torsion: Gamma = {1, gamma}, gamma^2 = 1, Gamma' = 1 gives U(Gamma') = M^n, U(Gamma) = emptyset. Torsion-freeness holds under CCAction (CCAction.pow_ne_one).

labels.label: nini

hypotheses.paper: Gamma the holonomy of a Cauchy-complete GH spacetime

findings: Not a ledger label (no b-prefix). Proved sorry-free: no nonspacelike elliptic, no transverse parabolic, no torsion.

kb_proposals: A statement whose type mentions no `d` (e.g. about `Deck (UniversalCover.proj M x₀)`) does not pick up section variable `{d}` nor `[ChartedSpace (Minkowski d) M]`: give it explicit `(d : ℕ)` binders outside the section; `hasGroupoid_flatCover M x₀` needs `(d := d)`.

Barbot §8's 'small convex neighbourhood B' arguments are best replaced by the domain of dependence: prove the inclusion on `dependenceDomain (minkowski d) ⊤ Σ`, then `graph_subset_interior_dependenceDomain` gives the interior.
`linOf g` elaborates to `AffineEquiv.linearHom ↑g`: multiplicativity is `show`, `Subgroup.coe_mul`/`coe_pow`/`coe_inv`, `map_mul`, `rfl`; use `linOf_mem g` (not `g.2`) for `lorentz` membership.

Mathlib has no continuity lemma for a strictly monotone map with interval image; `Flat.Develop.continuousOn_of_strictMonoOn` gives it, which is what lifting a `StrictlyExtends` reparametrisation through a covering needs.
